citation: Haas, Jonathan; Creamer, Winifred; Ruiz, Alvaro. 2004. “Dating the Late Archaic occupation of the Norte Chico region in Peru.” Nature 432 (7020): 1020–1023. DOI 10.1038/nature03146.
notes: Peer-reviewed Nature letter presenting 95 new radiocarbon dates from 13 of more than 20 large early sites in Fortaleza and Pativilca valleys (Norte Chico: Huaura, Supe, Pativilca, Fortaleza). Late Archaic complex ~3000–1800 cal BCE; large-scale monumental and residential architecture; lack of ceramics. Secondary journal article presenting primary dating results — same tier practice as Science 2001 Caral paper.
